actual_rule_observed: Removing the source page removes its nav entry; the remaining items keep their relative order, so every item below the removed one moves up exactly one index.
filename: content/about.md (moved aside for the probe build, then restored)
notes: About (order 3) vanished from the nav; Feed moved from index 3 to index 2; Home and Archive kept indices 0 and 1. Consistent with the documented collection-driven model (nav is built from collections.all, so a page with no source template cannot appear). Nuance: _site/about/index.html from the previous build was NOT cleaned by the rebuild (Eleventy does not wipe stale output), but the nav item was gone. about.md was restored afterwards (git working tree clean) and a final rebuild confirmed the baseline nav [Home, Archive, About, Feed] was restored.
